title: The Magic of Numbers
author: IHEZA Education
description: A heartwarming play in three acts about Jason, a 12-year-old who struggles with math. With the help of his teacher Mr. Sam, he discovers that math is like a language, a mystery, and a game. Jason goes from hating fractions to winning the Math Challenge! Perfect for Grade 5 students.

title: The Dreamer
author: IHEZA Education
description: A story about Fakihi, a 12-year-old boy from Mwanza, Tanzania, who dreams of becoming a football superstar. Despite poverty and mockery, he trains with a tattered ball, finds a mentor in Mzee Juma, and journeys to Dar es Salaam for a tournament that changes his life. A tale of determination, hard work, and never giving up.
subject: English

title: The Weight of Envy
author: IHEZA Education
description: Emma and Clara are best friends until jealousy tears them apart. Clara's envy of Emma's academic brilliance leads to bullying, sabotage, and heartbreak. But when Emma's spirit is nearly broken, Clara must confront her actions and find a path to redemption. A powerful story about jealousy, forgiveness, and the strength of true friendship.
subject: English
